_comment: Default configuration for the calendar addon. Override any key in app-custom-config.json.
_comment_calendar_manage: #1220 — the calendar addon declares the permission its management routes ask for, and grants it to admin. A deployment grants calendar-manage to its own role (a clubhouse manager, say) in app-custom-config.json: add the role to the subjects of calendar-manage-access, or add a policy of your own. The addon never names a role.

calendar-manage.description: Create, edit and delete calendar events; see private reservation details; cancel any reservation
